# part3-method-quality-gate-report-gn51-53

**Scope(s):** `OBJECT` · **Row count:** 3 · **Lifecycle (candidate):** DORMANT · **Layer (provisional):** LAYER-UNRESOLVED
**Notations:** `AF-F-24..29, MV-F-19`, `GN-51/GN-53 integrated report`, `RED/AMBER/GREEN classification (GN-52)` · **Aliases:** `PART III METHOD & QUALITY GATE — INTEGRATED REPORT`
**Candidate group membership (NOT an identity claim):** Ungrouped — no mechanical signal connected this label to any other in P2a.

## Sources (how this label entered the ledger)
- **OBJECT-INDEX** (batch B0033, scope OBJECT): The integrated GN-51/GN-53 gate report (2026-08-29) combining the producer mechanical suite, an independent fresh-context review, and the standing GN-44/46/48-49 verification corpus, read through the GN-52 supervision model. Verdicts: Part III PASSES WITH CORRECTIONS REQUIRED (no blocking finding, corrections book-side/bounded/synoptic-illustrative only); Method ADJUSTED (core method twice-proven, but a recurrent defect family -- synoptic/cross-artifact/post-edit material unchecked by mechanical gates -- requires seven named adjustments before Parts II/IV/I); substantive depth: 9 chapters FULL-DEPTH, III.9 ADEQUATE, word-range deviations judged density-first and explicitly NOT corrections (recommend recalibrating ranges for later parts rather than padding); all five HPA questions answered YES; all ten GN-45 corrections verified in place and non-regressive; new findings AF-F-25..29 (1 MINOR, 4 OBSERVATION, all synoptic/illustrative) plus AF-F-24 verified and MV-F-19 confirmed still standing (its fix was never authorized). Produces a RED/AMBER/GREEN classification (RED: four bounded book-side corrections requiring authorization, e.g. removing III.2's two 'Lord' tokens and fixing a false claims.md line, two MV-F-19 over-strength phrasings, a false parenthetical, and an under-count error; AMBER: seven method adjustments plus three minor findings and III.9's evidence-gated residuals; GREEN: depth deviations, evidence-gated refusals, OQ ownership labels, and several named items explicitly protected from over-editing) and a list of items MUST NOT CHANGE (architecture/research findings outside the book's authority: two annotation rulings, four architectural candidates, compression acceptances, R1/R2/R3, OQ-1..12, riders, v1.1, AF-F-8/17). Proposes a four-item GN-54 ruling skeleton: authorize the RED corrections; adopt the seven method adjustments for later parts; accept the PASSES-WITH-CORRECTIONS verdict; authorize Part II production start after corrections.
